faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PM Shri Balikonta School Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 31st August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Physical Education and a Graduate degree in a Yoga-related field to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Chhattisgarh government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer role?
faq.answer: The selection process will primarily involve the preparation of a Merit List followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website to download the application form?
faq.answer: The official website where you can download the application form is https://bastar.gov.in.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for a contractual position as a Yoga/Sports Teacher/Trainer.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article, or directly from the official website mentioned.
